verdict.rationale: Retell documents some self-running, user-configured behaviour. Deployed agents answer calls on their own and can take real actions through function calls. AI QA automatically evaluates sampled calls against rules you configure, and per-agent retention automatically deletes data after a set period. There is no general-purpose automation builder, scheduler or recurring background job runner, and Conductor only proposes changes for you to review before applying. Missing for 10: general user-defined background automations or workflows, scheduled/recurring triggers (e.g. scheduled outbound campaigns), autonomous agent-driven background tasks beyond live calls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of your calls against rules and metrics you configure.
After the retention period expires, call and chat data associated with that agent is automatically and permanently deleted.
Function calling lets Retell single or multi-prompt agents take real actions — transfer calls, end calls, book appointments, send SMS, and call external APIs.
